products.name: Raw - Classic Cones - Dog Walker - Single - 70/24
products.description: RAW Classic Cones Dog Walker Singles deliver the iconic RAW rolling paper experience in a perfectly pre-rolled, convenient format. These slim, compact cones are crafted from natural unrefined paper that burns slow and even, letting you enjoy pure flavor without any unwanted additives. Ideal for solo sessions or on-the-go enjoyment, the Dog Walker size offers a quick, satisfying smoke that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle. RAW's signature quality shines through in every cone, with a classic brown hue and watermark that prevents runs. Whether you're new to rolling papers or a seasoned enthusiast, these single cones provide hassle-free convenience without compromising on authenticity or taste. Perfect for the cannabis consumer who values natural, unprocessed accessories that enhance rather than interfere with their experience.

products.name: Raw - Organic Rolling Papers - Black - 1 1/4
products.description: RAW Organic Rolling Papers in Black deliver the premium smoking experience you expect from the trusted RAW brand. These 1 1/4 size rolling papers are crafted from organic materials, providing a clean, pure burn that lets you taste your flower without interference. The sleek black design adds style to your session while maintaining the ultra-thin, slow-burning quality RAW is famous for. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts who value natural, unrefined products, these organic rolling papers contain no additives or chemicals—just pure plant fibers that complement your favorite strains. Whether you're rolling for solo sessions or sharing with friends, RAW Black Organic papers offer smooth, even burns every time. Stock up on this essential cannabis accessory and elevate your smoking ritual with papers that prioritize quality, sustainability, and performance.
